_about: Facts for scoring. status: verified = read by a person at native resolution on the kit built from the original PDF (2026-09-07); disputed = cannot be settled reliably yet, goes to the owner for a decision. Counts below are LABEL counts, each placed with page coordinates in kit/out/marked/p2X-labels.csv (one label, one mark); a member count is settled only where noted, never from a model or from two models agreeing. The app's saved reading is not ground truth.
